name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_chronic_active_hepatitis_c_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of chronic hepatitis C.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of chronic hepatitis C.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of chronic hepatitis C.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of chronic hepatitis C.

name: patient_has_undergone_interferon_antiviral_therapy_inthehistory@@administered_with_ribavirin

when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether ribavirin was co-administered with interferon antiviral therapy.
